g.text: Original Gamma mass, center and weights: RPCJ9; RPE5–9.
Degree three: the old inverse diverges; all four labels are retained
Exact exponents: RPCJ14–23. Four distinct old marks, two-scalar inverse and full metric: RPE10–26.
Human sources: ES reader v69 (The Clankers; underlying Alpöge/Fable/Tao example), and the cited DLMF Chapter 18 authors for the Gamma dictionary.
